name: Student-Perfomance-Project
description: An interactive machine learning application for predicting student academic performance. Powered by a Random Forest model, it provides real-time classifications, deep behavioral insights, and actionable improvement plans.

paragraphs: An end-to-end machine learning application designed to predict student academic performance based on various demographic, parental, and behavioral factors. This project utilizes a Random Forest classifier to categorize students into performance levels: Passing, Average, or Low.

Academic performance is influenced by a wide array of factors beyond simple study habits. The Student Performance Predictor aims to provide educators and parents with a data-driven tool to identify at-risk students early and provide targeted interventions.
features: Performance Classification: Instantly categorize student performance based on key metrics.
Interactive Insights: Detailed breakdown of the factors influencing individual predictions.
Performance Gauge: Visual representation of a student's performance potential.
Profile Analysis: Analysis of study time, absences, and parental support.
Actionable Recommendations: Automated suggestions for performance improvement.
